name: Prometheus
overview: The industry standard for metric scraping. Excellent ecosystem support, but pull-based scraping requires explicit exporter configuration on all edge nodes.
details: Prometheus is the foundational tool of the cloud-native observability stack. It strictly operates on a pull-based model, gathering metrics from designated targets at regular intervals.

For OpenClaw, Prometheus is perfectly adequate for Tier 1 monolithic setups. However, as the cluster scales across multiple nodes, its storage engine becomes less efficient than purpose-built columnar TSDBs like VictoriaMetrics.
